problem_statement: Starting from the Petersen graph G0 (10-vertex, 3-regular, spectrum {3^1,1^5,-2^4}), find explicit signing vectors s1 in {+1,-1}^15 and s2 in {+1,-1}^30 defining iterated 2-lifts G1 (20 vertices) and G2 (40 vertices) such that each Gi is connected, non-bipartite, 3-regular, and Ramanujan (all nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues |lambda| <= 2*sqrt(2) ~= 2.828), with the bound certified by exact integer characteristic polynomials of the signed quotient matrices plus rigorous interval/Sturm root bounds. Establish girth, diameter, and switching-class optimality of s1.
